title: Fix blob probing security section to address correct attack vector
description: §4.3 (line 218-224) describes the blob probing threat but the mitigation is wrong. The real threat is cross-account probing via server-side blob deduplication: client uploads a known blob and infers whether another account has the same content by observing shared blobIds or response latency. The current mitigation 'only the uploading account can observe sha256' doesn't address this — sha256 is always visible to the uploader by definition. Rewrite to focus on cross-account deduplication policy.
